a: Varies. NSF 26-523 covers about 300 awards and $180M across all Physics programs. No per-award cap is stated
dt: FY2027 target date: second Tuesday in January (Jan 12, 2027). NSF 26-523 accepts proposals anytime, but PoLS keeps this target date
e: Faculty at US institutions; single investigators or physicist–biologist teams. NSF 26-523 replaces NSF 23-615 and 23-607. It has no per-PI proposal limit, but NSF asks for single submission with co-review. CAREER proposals go through the separate CAREER solicitation.
n: NSF Physics of Living Systems (PoLS), MPS Physics solicitation NSF 26-523
